A '''settlement''' was located just south of the [[Rust Yards]], an industrial site on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The settlement was home to the workers who were employed at the Rust Yards, such as [[Ezra (Cold War)|Ezra]] and her husband [[Rand (worker)|Rand]].
